arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import subprocess,sys,time,resource,os
data=open('/workspace/tmp/t/big.json','rb').read()
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'launch.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
el=time.time()-t
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall',round(el,2),'out bytes',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:400])
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('child cpu user',round(u.ru_utime,2),'sys',round(u.ru_stime,2),'maxrss MB',u.ru_maxrss/1024)
"
